Thanks for reporting this. Vidstack Player is in security-only maintenance until January 2028, and security reports are the one kind of issue we still handle.

Please report vulnerabilities privately as described in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/vidstack/player/blob/main/SECURITY.md), so a fix can ship before the details are public. If this issue includes exploit details, consider editing them out. A maintainer will review it.
